patch_resolves_note: The switched fixed source rejects the staged zero-length header before `param->armorhdr` is materialized, and the adjacent `begin_pgp_message_header` witness shows the same fixed binary still materializes a header only when the exact `BEGIN PGP MESSAGE` length obligation is satisfied.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `armor_str_to_data_type()` may classify a candidate armor header as `PGP_ARMORED_MESSAGE`, the candidate length `len` must exactly match `"BEGIN PGP MESSAGE"` instead of comparing only an attacker-chosen prefix length.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original admits a zero-length interior string as `BEGIN PGP MESSAGE` because `strncmp(..., len)` is called with `len == 0`. The fixed original is guarded on the staged PoC (`0 != 17`, no `param->armorhdr` materialization), and the adjacent `begin_pgp_message_header` witness reaches the same materialization event with `17 == 17`.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original violates the required predicate while the protected `armorhdr_materialized` event executes. The fixed original records the same root event with `header_name_len=0`, but the protected event is absent; the constructive `begin_pgp_message_header` case makes the fixed required assertion genuine with `header_name_len=17` and `armorhdr_materialized` present.

nodes.description: The attacker-controlled header name length admitted by `armor_str_to_data_type()` is the same length materialized into heap string `param->armorhdr`.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `armor_type_check.header_name_len == armorhdr_materialized.header_name_len == 0`.

nodes.description: At the `memcpy` sink, the copy length expression `stlen - 5` wraps past the actual header length `stlen`, matching the saved `negative-size-param` crash.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `trailer_copy.copy_len=18446744073709551611 > trailer_copy.header_name_len=0`.

edges.relation: The same candidate header-name length that `armor_str_to_data_type()` accepts is materialized unchanged into `param->armorhdr` as `armhdrlen - 10`.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `armor_type_check.header_name_len == armorhdr_materialized.header_name_len == 0`; the fixed witness preserves the same equality at `17` when materialization genuinely occurs.

edges.relation: The header length materialized in `param->armorhdr` is the same length later measured as `stlen` at the trailer-copy sink.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `armorhdr_materialized.header_name_len == trailer_copy.header_name_len == 0`.
